text:
harper: ran a quick bring-up for nomad13b across fp16 / int6 / two per-channel int4 variants. focus was mixed chat + table-extraction slices. posting highlights and routing recs.

diego: paste the summary numbers please.

harper: ok: fp16 p50=92ms, unit cost ~$125/1M tokens. int6 p50=71ms, ~$52/1M. pc-int4 (ff-only int4) p50=62ms, ~$40/1M. pc-int4 (attn-only int4) p50=64ms, ~$41/1M.

gina: quality deltas? any catastrophic slices?

harper: average ROUGE-L deltas vs fp16: int6 -0.5, pc-int4(ff) -1.4, pc-int4(attn) -1.9. two hotspots: "table-extract" EM down ~3.6 for attn-int4, "multi-edit threading" ROUGE-L down ~2.7 for ff-int4. short-turn chat unaffected (<0.5 RL).

diego: production prevalence? how common are those slices?

harper: table-extract ~6% of GTN traffic, higher in analytics beta (~15%). multi-edit ~3.5% overall but spikes in some enterprise workloads.

gina: product constraints: offer fast default for freemium, but no regressions for analytics/legal enterprise. routing idea?

harper: recommended policy: default -> pc-int4(ff-only) for best latency/cost. Predicates (route to int6/fp16): 1) presence of table markers ("|" or CSV tokens) 2) tokens>320 3) user_tier enterprise OR explicit high-fidelity opt-in 4) user-request flag "preserve-table". Also a cheap model-based signal: quick embed+logit-margin classifier to detect potential hallucination-prone prompts.

diego: ops complexity? cheap regex for tables is fine. embed classifier adds ~2ms but acceptable if cached.

ops-bot: rollout checklist created:
- add config flag: quant.nomad.default=pc-int4-ff
- add predicates: table_regex, token_count, user_tier, preserve_table_flag, embed_hallucination_score
- metric: quant_fallback_rate, avg_unit_cost, perceived_quality_complaints
- canary: 3% traffic for 72h, shadow int6 for 5% traffic for 24h
- alert if fallback_rate > 9% sustained or complaint spike

gina: need a monitoring scorecard for weekly review. small eval set: 75 table-extraction cases + 50 multi-edit cases. track EM, ROUGE-L, human_accept_rate.

harper: quick mock scorecard:
```
slice: short-chat           | FP16 RL 45.0 | PC-INT4(FF) RL 44.6 | delta -0.4 | cost ratio 0.32
slice: table-extract       | FP16 EM 88.0 | PC-INT4(ATTN) EM 84.4 | delta -3.6 | cost ratio 0.33
slice: multi-edit-thread   | FP16 RL 43.8 | PC-INT4(FF) RL 41.1 | delta -2.7 | cost ratio 0.32
human_accept: FP16 96.0% | PC-INT4 94.0% | delta -2.0pts
unit_cost_per_1M: FP16 $125 | INT6 $52 | PC-INT4 $40
```

diego: recommendation options: conservative = default int6 (~$52/1M); pragmatic (favored) = default pc-int4(ff) + predicates to int6/fp16 (expected avg ~$44/1M); aggressive = pc-int4-only (lowest cost ~$40/1M but higher risk).

gina: GTN messaging draft: "Nomad13b delivers large cost savings on typical chat workloads while automated fidelity rails ensure table extraction and threaded editing scenarios are handled at higher precision when needed." Keep enterprise opt-in for guaranteed fp16.

harper: ML action: schedule a 48h per-layer sweep (attn vs ff quant) plus an int6/per-channel int5 (if possible) quick pass to see if we can bridge the table gap. estimate 3xA100-80GB for 48h. will push results to the scorecard.

diego: ops ask: log per-request predicate hits and post-canary user complaint correlation. tracker-bot: create a ticket for canary review and link owners.

tracker-bot: ticket created and assigned: quant/nomad13b/routing-canary. owners: harper (ML), diego (ops), gina (product). due: canary+72h review.

ops-bot: reminder set for canary review in 72h and for human-eval results in 10 days.

gina: agreed — leaning pragmatic. harper please post sweep stub when scheduled.

harper: on it. will upload sweep configs and initial numbers once available. :rocket:
